answer.question: What do these sources tell us about the benefits and main limitations of metformin for type 2 diabetes?
answer.generation_note: Generated with Cloudflare Workers AI using indexed sources. Check citations for support. Combination-product labels were excluded from this single-ingredient summary.
answer.short_answer:
The FDA labels for metformin indicate it is used to improve glycemic control in adults and pediatric patients 10 years of age and older with type 2 diabetes mellitus [openFDA label:FDA-LABEL-metformin-3] [openFDA label:FDA-LABEL-metformin-2].

The main limitations of metformin include the risk of lactic acidosis, vitamin B12 deficiency, and hypoglycemia, particularly when used with other medications [openFDA label:FDA-LABEL-metformin-3] [openFDA label:FDA-LABEL-metformin-2].
